result.instructions: Tools for REVIEWS.io, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What is our average store rating and how many reviews do we have?"; "Show our newest product reviews with the star rating for each."; "What is the average rating of the product with SKU TSHIRT-01?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes REVIEWS.io data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run reviewsio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run reviewsio_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run reviewsio_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. reviewsio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_reviews
tools.title: List reviews and questions
tools.description: The recommended way to read reviews: company (store) reviews, product reviews, third-party reviews and product questions in one filterable timeline, with the account's private data (reviewer e-mail, order). Filter by type, SKU/MPN/GTIN, tag, branch, keyword, date range, minimum rating, photos/videos; sort newest-first by default. Pages are 1-based; next_page is set when more results remain. GET /reviews.

type.description: What to return (default: all review kinds).

sku.description: Product SKUs, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

mpn.description: Product MPNs, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

gtin.description: Product GTINs, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

tag.description: Review tags, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

branch.description: Only reviews of this branch name.

keyword.description: Only reviews whose text contains this keyword.

email.description: Only reviews left by this e-mail address.

with.description: Only reviews with active photos, videos or either.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_company_reviews
tools.title: List company reviews
tools.description: Company (store) reviews with private data (order number, reviewer details, tags) and optionally the replies. Filter by rating range, dates, order number, branch, invitation id; order by date or rating. Pages are 0-based; next_page is set when more remain. GET /merchant/reviews.

order_number.description: Only reviews for this order number.

branch.description: Only reviews of this branch name.

invitation_id.description: Only the review that answered this invitation (service_feedback_email_id).

min_date.description: Reviews created on or after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

max_date.description: Reviews created on or before this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

max_updated.description: Reviews not updated after this date (yyyy-mm-dd).

order.description: Order by date ascending/descending, or by rating.

include_replies.description: Include the store's replies to each review.

tools.name: reviewsio_get_review_stats
tools.title: Get review statistics
tools.description: Basic review statistics: average rating and review count for product reviews, company reviews and third-party reviews. GET /stats/all.

tools.name: reviewsio_get_product_ratings
tools.title: Get product ratings
tools.description: Average rating and review count for one or more products by SKU (batch). GET /product/rating-batch.

sku.description: Product SKUs, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

tools.name: reviewsio_get_review_nuggets
tools.title: Get review nuggets
tools.description: Short, highlight-worthy review snippets (nuggets) of company and/or product reviews, for marketing. Filter by SKU, tags, branch, minimum rating. GET /review-nuggets/data.

types.description: Which review kinds to draw nuggets from.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_ugc
tools.title: List user generated content
tools.description: Customer photos/videos (UGC) collected through REVIEWS.io, filterable by SKU, tag, category or videos only. GET /ugc.

sku.description: Product SKUs, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

tags.description: Tags, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

categories.description: Categories, separated by semicolons for several (e.g. "SKU-1;SKU-2").

tools.name: reviewsio_list_surveys
tools.title: List surveys
tools.description: The store's surveys (campaigns) with their ids; use an id with reviewsio_list_survey_responses. GET /widget/surveys.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_survey_responses
tools.title: List survey responses
tools.description: The responses submitted to one survey. Get the survey id from reviewsio_list_surveys. GET /widget/survey-responses.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_product_invitations
tools.title: List product invitations
tools.description: Product review invitations that are queued or sent (customer, order, send date, status); filter by SKU, order id or sent state, and page through with page/limit. GET /product/invitation.

sku.description: Only invitations for this product SKU.

order_id.description: Only invitations for this order id.

invite_sent.description: true = only invitations already sent, false = only those still queued.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_company_invitations
tools.title: List company invitations
tools.description: Company review invitations that are queued or sent (customer, order, send date, status); filter by order id or sent state, and page through with page/limit. GET /merchant/invitations.

order_id.description: Only invitations for this order id.

invite_sent.description: true = only invitations already sent, false = only those still queued.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_unsubscribed_users
tools.title: List unsubscribed users
tools.description: E-mail addresses that unsubscribed from (or were unsubscribed from) REVIEWS.io invitation e-mails. GET /unsubscribe/list.

tools.name: reviewsio_list_webhooks
tools.title: List webhooks
tools.description: The review-submitted webhooks registered for the store (read-only; this server never adds or removes webhooks). GET /webhook/list.

tools.name: reviewsio_tag_company_review
tools.title: Tag a company review
tools.description: WRITE: adds a tag to one company review (visible in your REVIEWS.io dashboard and usable as a filter). Adding the same tag twice changes nothing. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /review/tag/{id}.

tag.description: The tag to add, e.g. positive-review. Tags help you filter and display reviews.

tools.name: reviewsio_tag_product_review
tools.title: Tag a product review
tools.description: WRITE: adds a tag to one product review (visible in your REVIEWS.io dashboard and usable as a filter). Adding the same tag twice changes nothing. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /product-review/tag/{id}.

tag.description: The tag to add, e.g. positive-review. Tags help you filter and display reviews.

tools.name: reviewsio_unsubscribe_user
tools.title: Unsubscribe a user from invitation e-mails
tools.description: WRITE: stops REVIEWS.io sending review invitation e-mails to one e-mail address. Use it for a customer who asked not to be contacted. This server has no tool to re-subscribe an address; it can only be undone in the REVIEWS.io dashboard. Nothing is sent to the customer. POST /unsubscribe/email.

annotations.title: Unsubscribe a user from invitation e-mails

tools.name: reviewsio_queue_company_invitation
tools.title: Queue one company review invitation (e-mails a customer)
tools.description: WRITE - SENDS A MESSAGE TO A REAL CUSTOMER: queues ONE company review invitation e-mail to the given customer address; REVIEWS.io then e-mails that person (when and with which template follows your Flow Sequence / template_id, usually within hours or days). It cannot be recalled from this server. Only call it when the user has explicitly asked to invite this exact customer, and pass confirm_send_email: true. There is no bulk or SMS invitation tool. POST /merchant/invitation.

name.description: The customer's name (used in the e-mail greeting).

email.description: The customer's e-mail address: the invitation is sent HERE.

template_id.description: Invitation e-mail template id (overrides the Flow Sequence template).

confirm_send_email.description: Must be true: confirms the user asked for a real e-mail to this customer.

annotations.title: Queue one company review invitation (e-mails a customer)
